laceworks_minder.text: Mind the machine. It weighs several tonnes and has thousands of threads. It does not stop for sightseers.
The patterns were guided by punched cards, borrowed from the Jacquard weaving loom. Punched cards later inspired early computers.
So the next time you use a laptop, thank a lace machine. Sort of.

laceworks_bobbin_fan.text: Bobbin turns up in empty mills at night and spins thread for fun. It is a terrible dinner guest and a fantastic tidier.
